ChipsSelection

The `m3e-chip` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Non-interactive chips

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.chipSet []
…
[ M3e.chip [] [ Kit.text "Confidential" ]
, M3e.chip [] [ Kit.text "Draft" ]
, M3e.chip [] [ Kit.text "Finance" ]
, M3e.chip [] [ Kit.text "Presentation" ]
]
M3e.ChipSet.view []
…
[ M3e.Chip.el { content = Kit.text "Confidential" } [] []
, M3e.Chip.el { content = Kit.text "Draft" } [] []
, M3e.Chip.el { content = Kit.text "Finance" } [] []
, M3e.Chip.el { content = Kit.text "Presentation" } [] []
]
M3e.ChipSet.build
|> M3e.ChipSet.withChild (M3e.Chip.view [] [ Kit.text "Confidential" ])
|> M3e.ChipSet.withChild (M3e.Chip.view [] [ Kit.text "Draft" ])
|> M3e.ChipSet.withChild (M3e.Chip.view [] [ Kit.text "Finance" ])
|> M3e.ChipSet.withChild (M3e.Chip.view [] [ Kit.text "Presentation" ])
|> M3e.ChipSet.toElement
<m3e-chip-set>
…
<m3e-chip>Confidential</m3e-chip>
<m3e-chip>Draft</m3e-chip>
<m3e-chip>Finance</m3e-chip>
<m3e-chip>Presentation</m3e-chip>
</m3e-chip-set>

Variants

M3eelbuildHTML
[ M3e.chip [] [ Kit.text "Outlined" ]
, M3e.chip [ M3e.Chip.variant M3e.Values.elevated ] [ Kit.text "Elevated" ]
]
[ M3e.Chip.el { content = Kit.text "Outlined" } [] []
, M3e.Chip.el { content = Kit.text "Elevated" } [ M3e.Chip.variant M3e.Values.elevated ] []
]
[ M3e.Chip.build { content = Kit.text "Outlined" }
|> M3e.Chip.toElement
, M3e.Chip.build { content = Kit.text "Elevated" }
|> M3e.Chip.withVariant M3e.Values.elevated
|> M3e.Chip.toElement
]
<m3e-chip>Outlined</m3e-chip>
<m3e-chip variant="elevated">Elevated</m3e-chip>

…

M3e.ChipSet.build
|> M3e.ChipSet.withVertical True
|> M3e.ChipSet.withChild (M3e.Chip.view [] [ Kit.text "Confidential" ])
|> M3e.ChipSet.withChild (M3e.Chip.view [] [ Kit.text "Draft" ])
|> M3e.ChipSet.withChild (M3e.Chip.view [] [ Kit.text "Finance" ])
|> M3e.ChipSet.withChild (M3e.Chip.view [] [ Kit.text "Presentation" ])
|> M3e.ChipSet.toElement
<m3e-chip-set vertical="">
…
<m3e-chip>Confidential</m3e-chip>
<m3e-chip>Draft</m3e-chip>
<m3e-chip>Finance</m3e-chip>
<m3e-chip>Presentation</m3e-chip>
</m3e-chip-set>

Icons

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.chip []
[ M3e.Chip.icon (M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "finance" ] [])
, Kit.text "Finance"
]
M3e.Chip.el { content = Kit.text "Finance" } [] [ M3e.Chip.icon (M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "finance" ] []) ]
M3e.Chip.build { content = Kit.text "Finance" }
|> M3e.Chip.withIcon (M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "finance" ] [])
|> M3e.Chip.toElement
<m3e-chip><m3e-icon slot="icon" name="finance"></m3e-icon>Finance</m3e-chip>

Disabling

M3eelbuildHTML
[ M3e.assistChip [ M3e.AssistChip.disabled True ] [ Kit.text "Disabled" ]
, M3e.assistChip [ M3e.AssistChip.disabledInteractive True ] [ Kit.text "Disabled Interactive" ]
]
[ M3e.AssistChip.el { content = Kit.text "Disabled" } [ M3e.AssistChip.disabled True ] []
, M3e.AssistChip.el { content = Kit.text "Disabled Interactive" } [ M3e.AssistChip.disabledInteractive True ] []
]
[ M3e.AssistChip.build { content = Kit.text "Disabled" }
|> M3e.AssistChip.withDisabled True
|> M3e.AssistChip.toElement
, M3e.AssistChip.build { content = Kit.text "Disabled Interactive" }
|> M3e.AssistChip.withDisabledInteractive True
|> M3e.AssistChip.toElement
]
<m3e-assist-chip disabled>Disabled</m3e-assist-chip>
<m3e-assist-chip disabled-interactive="">Disabled Interactive</m3e-assist-chip>

Links

[]
M3e.AssistChip.build { content = Kit.text "Google" }

API
Constructor
type Is

The kind row m3e-chip produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type IconSlot

The kinds the icon slot admits.

type TrailingIconSlot

The kinds the trailing-icon slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Variant

The variant values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Other
component : { content : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Chip.Content (M3e.Component.Chip.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg } -> List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.Chip.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Chip.Content (M3e.Component.Chip.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.Chip.Is s) admittedBy msg

Required-content (and action) constructor — omissions are unwritable.

variant : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Chip.Variant -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | variant : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The appearance variant of the chip. (default: "outlined")

value : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | value : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.value.

defaultValue : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | value : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.defaultValue.

icon : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Chip.IconSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named icon slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

trailingIcon : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Chip.TrailingIconSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named trailing-icon slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

child : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Chip.Content admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place a pre-built element into the default (unnamed) slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list). The list-form sibling of the builder's withChild.
